findings.claim: aso_replica_error labels every non-503 failure "replica_grant_denied", so a malformed request (invalid or duplicated practiceId, which selected_practice rejects with BAD_REQUEST) returns HTTP 400 with the misleading body {"error": "replica_grant_denied"}, and that 400 path has no test in the packet.
findings.evidence: aso_replica_grant.rs: `selected_practice` returns `Err(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST)` for an unparseable or repeated `practiceId`; pipeline.rs: `fn aso_replica_error(status)` maps any status other than SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE to `"replica_grant_denied"`. The visible unit tests in aso_replica_grant.rs cover only forged-claim and wrong-revision refusals, and scripts/test-replica-grant.py never sends an invalid practiceId, so the client-format failure class is both mislabeled and unverified.
findings.suggested_fix: Distinguish the 400 case (e.g., "invalid_projection_request", matching the ASO handler's vocabulary) and add a unit test asserting duplicate/invalid practiceId yields 400 before any callback or mint occurs.

findings.claim: The expiry + human-principal guard pair is now hand-duplicated in three places (current_session, replica_grant, clinical_context), and the packet's own red receipts prove this exact duplication already drifted once: current_session shipped without the guards while replica_grant had them.
findings.evidence: completion_evidence/task-10-current-session-guard-red.txt shows `mounted_current_session_refuses_expired_or_nonhuman_port_results` failing with `left: 200, right: 401` on a handler missing guards that replica_grant already contained; the fix copies the same two `Ok(summary) if ...` arms into current_session rather than sharing a helper. A fourth future session-derived endpoint has no compile-time or shared-code force preventing the same omission.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract a single `guard_summary(state, summary) -> Result<SessionSummary, Response>` (or fold the checks into one shared resolver wrapper) used by current_session, replica_grant and clinical_context so the principal/expiry refusal cannot diverge per endpoint.
